1. (Currently amended) A method of using a finger palette to transfer cosmetics from a container to a destination, the finger palette including: a ring portion that is securable to a finger; and __a surface portion secured to the ring portion, wherein the surface portion includes at least one textured feature or pattern configured to facilitate controlled transfer of cosmetic product__; the method including the steps of: securing the finger palette to a finger; depositing a cosmetic product onto the surface portion of the finger palette; and transferring the cosmetic product from the surface portion of the finger palette to a destination.

4. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein: a. a first quantity of the cosmetic product is deposited onto the surface portion; and b. a second quantity of the cosmetic product is transferred from the surface portion to the destination, the second quantity being smaller than the first quantity, __wherein the surface portion is configured to retain a portion of the first quantity on the surface portion after the second quantity is transferred__.

5. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein: a. the surface portion extends outwardly from a surface center to an outer perimeter; and b. __the surface portion includes at least one recessed area or edge feature that is configured to contain cosmetics during blending or mixing operations__.

6. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein __the surface portion includes at least one raised feature, ridge, or textured area configured to facilitate spreading or blending of cosmetic product__.

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein __the surface portion is contoured with at least one depression, groove, or curved feature that facilitates controlled application of cosmetic product__.

11. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the finger palette is secured to the finger by passing the finger through the ring portion, __and wherein the ring portion is sized and shaped to provide a secure fit that allows the user to maintain control of the surface portion during cosmetic product application__.
